profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Your account, your password and the devices you are signed in on.

password.changedHere: Your password was changed. You were signed out on your other devices; you stay signed in here.

picture.title: Profile picture
picture.removeBody: Your initial will be shown instead, everywhere.
picture.previewHint: This is how your new picture will look. Save it, or cancel to keep the current one.
picture.rules: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to {size} MB. Other employees see it.
picture.tooLarge: The picture is larger than {size} MB.
picture.unavailable: Profile pictures can't be stored on this server yet.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.ownHint: The devices signed in to your account. This session is listed first and ends when you sign out.
sessions.employeeHint: Where this employee is signed in. Logging a session out ends it at once.
sessions.noOtherSessions: You are not signed in anywhere else.
sessions.noneForEmployee: This employee is not signed in anywhere.

confirm.oneOwnBody: {device} will be signed out at once and will need your password to sign in again.
confirm.oneEmployeeBody: {name} will be signed out of {device} at once.
confirm.allBody: {name} will be signed out everywhere at once — including the session they are using now.

users.protectedAccount: Super Administrator — managed by its owner
users.initialPasswordHint: At least 6 characters, including at least one letter. The employee must change it at their first sign-in.
users.created: Employee created. They sign in with the initial password and must choose their own right away.

errors.cannotRevokeCurrentSession: This is the session you are using. To end it, sign out.
errors.superAdministratorProtected: A Super Administrator's account can only be managed by its owner: their sessions, lock, password and roles are out of reach.
errors.ownSessionsOnProfile: Manage your own sessions from your profile.
errors.profilePictureTypeNotAllowed: Profile pictures must be PNG, JPG or WebP images.
errors.profilePictureCorrupt: That image is empty or damaged.
errors.profilePictureStorageUnavailable: Profile pictures can't be stored right now.
errors.profilePictureStorageFailed: The picture couldn't be stored. Nothing was changed; please try again.

validation.mfaCodeExpired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
validation.mfaTooManyAttempts: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new one.

login.sessionRevokedNotice: You were signed out because this session was ended from another device or by an administrator. Please sign in again.
login.passwordChangedElsewhereNotice: Your password was changed, so this device was signed out. Please sign in with the new password.

errors.mfaCodeInvalid: That code is not right. Check the e-mail and try again.
errors.mfaChallengeExpired: This code has expired or was already used. Sign in again to get a new one.
errors.mfaTooManyAttempts: Too many wrong codes. Sign in again to get a new one.
errors.mfaResendTooSoon: Please wait a moment before asking for another code.
errors.mfaTooManyCodes: Too many codes were sent to this account. Try again later.
errors.mfaEmailUnavailable: E-mail can't be sent from this server, so two-factor authentication can't be turned on.
errors.mfaMandatory: Your role requires two-factor authentication, so it can't be turned off.
